name: Foxlee Waterfalls
description:
Foxlee Track Waterfalls Exploration
Date: 24/05/25
Leader: Luen

Join us for an off-track adventure along the scenic Foxlee Track in Paluma Range National Park. We'll begin by hiking up the well-formed Foxlee Track to approximately 350 m elevation, where we'll leave the path and venture into the forest to explore a series of remote, little-known waterfalls. After enjoying these natural features and a relaxed break, we’ll return to the main track and follow it back downhill to the cars. Expect some off-track navigation, uneven terrain, and possibly slippery rocks near the falls. Suitable for fit walkers comfortable with moderate off-track exploration.

RSVP by emailing luenwarneke@gmail.com
